heroHeadline: Cernavodă's Two Reactors Head Into a Third Week Offline as Sixth Heat Dome Grips Italy and the Balkans
heroSubtitle: Romania's scheduled Unit 2 outage window lapses at midnight with no restart confirmed as the temporary Danube guide dam and Olt River releases continue; EU wildfire total holds near 634,500 hectares while Serbia's Deliblato Sands fire — over 3,500 hectares and backed by EU rescEU helicopters and a Russian Ilyushin waterbomber — is confirmed as the season's largest Balkan blaze after weeks of flare-ups.
